y-m-13-11.title: Uma sikhulisa isikwele, kwenzekani emjikelezweni nasendaweni?
y-m-13-11.topic: Ubudlelwano bokuthi uhlangothi lwesikwele nomjikelezo wayo nendawo kushintsha kanjani
y-m-13-11.goal: Phenya ngezibonelo eziningana ukuthi umjikelezo nendawo kuba yizikhathi ezingaki uma uhlangothi luba yizikhathi ezithile, thola umthetho phakathi komphindo wohlangothi nomphindo wendawo, futhi uchaze ukuthi kungani.
y-m-13-11.material: UDoyun wathi, 'Uma uphindaphinda uhlangothi olulodwa lwesikwele ngo-2, umjikelezo uphindeka kabili futhi nendawo iphindeka kabili.' Lapha, isikwele sinobude bohlangothi obuyinombolo yemvelo ye-cm, futhi iyunithi yendawo ngamasentimitha asikwele (cm²).
y-m-13-11.s.s1.prompt: Isikwele esinohlangothi olungu-3cm sakhuliswa ukuze uhlangothi lube ngu-6cm. Umjikelezo nendawo kuzoba yizikhathi ezingaki zokuqala ngakunye?
y-m-13-11.s.s1.hint.0: Thola umjikelezo nendawo ku-3cm kanye no-6cm wohlangothi futhi uzibhale ethebuleni.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.hint.1: Beka amanani okuqala namanani ngemuva kokukhulisa eceleni komunye futhi uthole ukuthi aba yizikhathi ezingaki.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.o.a: Umjikelezo uyizikhathi ezingu-2, indawo iyizikhathi ezingu-4
y-m-13-11.s.s1.r.a: Uqinisekise ngokubala ukuthi uma uhlangothi luphindeka kabili, umjikelezo nendawo kushintsha ngemiphindo ehlukile.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.o.b: Umjikelezo uyizikhathi ezingu-2, indawo nayo iyizikhathi ezingu-2
y-m-13-11.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu kuyafana namazwi kaDoyun. Thola wena indawo yokuqala 3×3 nendawo ngemuva kokukhulisa 6×6 futhi uziqhathanise.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.o.c: Umjikelezo uyizikhathi ezingu-4, indawo iyizikhathi ezingu-4
y-m-13-11.s.s1.r.c: Umjikelezo yisamu lobude bezinhlangothi ezine. Thola ukuthi umjikelezo wokuqala ongu-12cm uba ngu-cm angakanani ngemuva kokukhulisa.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.o.d: Umjikelezo uyizikhathi ezingu-2, indawo iyizikhathi ezingu-3
y-m-13-11.s.s1.r.d: Indawo itholwa ngokuphindaphinda ubude nobubanzi. Bheka ukuthi kwenzekani ebudeni nasebubanzini uma uhlangothi luphindeka kabili.
y-m-13-11.s.s1.explain: Uma uhlangothi lungu-3cm, umjikelezo ungu-12cm futhi indawo ingu-9cm², futhi uma uhlangothi lungu-6cm, umjikelezo ungu-24cm futhi indawo ingu-36cm². Umjikelezo uyizikhathi ezingu-2, kodwa indawo iyizikhathi ezingu-4. U-'indawo iphindeka kabili nayo' kaDoyun akulungile kulesi sibonelo.
y-m-13-11.s.s2.prompt: Indawo yesikwele ohlangothi lwaso lukhuliswe laba yizikhathi ezingu-k zokuqala iba yizikhathi ezingu-m zendawo yokuqala. (U-k uyinombolo yemvelo kusuka ku-2 kuya ku-10.) Faka amapheya angu-3 alungile ahlukile (k, m). Ungahlola nangokuthola wena indawo yesikwele.
y-m-13-11.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ngokulandelana izindawo zezikwele ezinezinhlangothi ezingu-1cm, 2cm, 3cm, 4cm futhi uthole ukuthi zaba yizikhathi ezingaki.
y-m-13-11.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ethebuleni imiphindo yendawo uma uhlangothi luyizikhathi ezingu-2 nezingu-3, futhi uthole ubudlelwano phakathi kwemiphindo emibili.

y-m-13-11.s.s2.fail.c2: Lapho uhlangothi luyizikhathi ezingu-k, indawo ayiyizikhathi ezingu-m. Hlola ngokubala wena.
y-m-13-11.s.s2.explain: Uma uhlangothi luyizikhathi ezi-2, indawo iyizikhathi ezi-4; uma ezi-3, ezi-9; uma ezi-4, ezi-16; uma ezi-5, ezi-25. y-m-13-11.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uhlole ukuthi umthetho wakho uhambisana nezikhathi zendawo zezikhathi ezi-2 nezi-3 zombili?
y-m-13-11.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe isizathu sokuthi ubude nobubanzi kokubili kukhula sixhumene nomthetho?
y-m-13-11.s.s2.because.model.0: Lapho uhlangothi luba yizikhathi ezingu-k, indawo iba yizikhathi ezingu-k×k. Ubude buba yizikhathi ezingu-k nobubanzi buba yizikhathi ezingu-k nabo, ngakho uphindaphinda inombolo efanayo kabili.

y-m-13-04.topic: Ukulinganisela izinombolo: ukuqagela ibanga lenombolo yangempela kusukela enanini elizungeziwe

y-m-13-03.title: Uma ufaka amabakaki, ingabe umphumela uzoshintsha ngokuqinisekile?
y-m-13-03.topic: Ukubala okuxubile ngezinombolo zemvelo: amabakaki nokulandelana kokubala
y-m-13-03.goal: Hlola isitatimende esithi 'ukufaka amabakaki kuhlala kukushintsha,' thola isibonelo esiphikisayo wena, bese uchaza isimo lapho umphumela ungashintshi khona.
y-m-13-03.material: UJiho wathi, 'Uma ufaka amabakaki esibalweni, umphumela uhlala ushintsha.' USua waphendula, 'Ingabe empeleni kuhlala kunjalo? Ngicabanga ukuthi kukhona amacala lapho ungashintshi.' Laba ababili banquma ukuqhathanisa izibalo ezimbili usebenzisa izinombolo ezintathu a, b, c. Isibalo ㉮ ngu-a + b × c (a kwengeziwe b izikhathi c), futhi isibalo ㉯ ngu-(a + b) × c (qala ubale a kwengeziwe b, bese uphindaphinda ngo-c). Zonke izinombolo ezintathu ziyizinombolo zemvelo ezingu-1 noma ngaphezulu, futhi zilandela isivumelwano sokuthi ukuphindaphinda kubalwa ngaphambi kokwengeza.

y-m-13-03.thinking.2: Ukusho isimo sokuthi kusebenze kusukela kulokho izibonelo ezinakho ngokufanayo
y-m-13-03.prereq.0: Isivumelwano sokubala ukuphindaphinda kuqala esibalweni esixube ukwengeza nokuphindaphinda
y-m-13-03.prereq.1: Isivumelwano sokubala ngaphakathi kwamabakaki kuqala uma kunamabakaki
y-m-13-03.s.s1.prompt: Uma a=2, b=3, c=4, ㉮ ngu-2 + 3 × 4 = 14 futhi ㉯ ngu-(2 + 3) × 4 = 20. Ungasho ini ngamazwi abantu ababili kusuka kulesi sibonelo esisodwa?
y-m-13-03.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi 14 no-20 zikhombisa amazwi kaJiho noma amazwi kaSua.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi udinga uhlobo luni lwesibonelo ukukhombisa ukuthi 'kuhlala kunjalo' kuphutha.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.o.a: Kushintshe kanye, ngakho ngingaqiniseka ukuthi amazwi kaJiho alungile kunoma yiziphi izinombolo ezintathu.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.r.a: Welule isibonelo esisodwa kuwo wonke amacala. Ukuhlola 'njalo,' udinga ukubheka zonke izinhlanganisela zezinombolo ezintathu.
y-m-13-03.s.s1.o.b: Amabakaki awathinti umphumela, ngakho amazwi kaSua alungile futhi amazwi kaJiho aphutha.
